subject: Align ML/Infra deep-dive — windows & operational prep
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@quantify.ai>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Align ML/Infra deep-dive — windows & operational prep

Hi Sanjay / Emily —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking through your latency and cost pain points. Quick recap and proposed next step: we recommend a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML + infra engineers to run through a model serving runbook, sample workload profile, and practical cost/latency optimizations (KV caching, batching, and quantization tradeoffs).

Who we suggest attend from your side: the person who owns model training/serving and someone from infra/security. From our side, I’ll bring Karthik (serving runtime), Marissa (solutions), and a platform engineer.

Draft agenda (attached: RDW-TDX-Agenda-v1.pdf):
- 5m quick intros & goals
- 15m workload & metric walk-through (your dataset sizes, QPS, latency targets)
- 25–40m hands-on: architecture + live run-through of serving options (batching, cache, quantization)
- 10–15m cost/SLAs & fallback policies
- 10m next steps / action items (rollout plan, evaluation buckets)

To schedule the session, can you pick one of these 90-minute windows next week (PDT times):
1) Tue May 4 — 10:00–11:30 PDT
2) Wed May 5 — 13:00–14:30 PDT
3) Thu May 6 — 08:30–10:00 PDT

If none fit, share a couple of windows and we’ll coordinate. Also: we attached a draft SOW for procurement (SOW-RDW-Acme-draft.docx) — not final, but useful for timelines.

Prep notes for you (short):
- We’ll need a short data-sample spec and a list of endpoints you plan to serve (we can accept anonymized examples)
- If you have non-negotiable compliance requirements (data residency, encryption-at-rest/HSM), flag them now so we can include the right product SMEs

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
[Attachment: RDW-TDX-Agenda-v1.pdf (agenda PDF)]
[Attachment: SOW-RDW-Acme-draft.docx (word doc)]

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@quantify.ai>

Cc: 
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Align ML/Infra deep-dive — windows & operational prep

Connor —

Thanks for the succinct recap and the agenda — that looks good. Emily and I discussed availability and our preference is option 2 (Wed May 5, 13:00–14:30 PDT). That slot hits our engineering sync sliver-free.

Couple of prep items from our side:
- We do need a short note on data residency implications (we operate EU + US tenants; primary model training data stays in EU) — can your team confirm what the private deployment option would look like?
- Can you include an example of the token-level cost breakdown for an Llama 2-ish base model so our finance partner has a ballpark before the deep dive?

If possible, add a short 10–15 minute segment on compliance paths (KMS/HSM, audit logs). Otherwise we can cover in next steps.

If Wed works for you, go ahead and send a calendar invite and we’ll accept.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Head of Engineering, Acme Analytics
sanjay@quantify.ai

Connor, can you please add Laura Bennett (solutions engineer) to the invite — she will demo live request/response traces and token-level cost breakdown.

- Marissa Cole — Solutions & customer success
- Karthik Iyer — Serving runtime engineer
- Laura Bennett — Solutions engineer (cost/observability demo)

I’ll update the agenda with a 10–15 minute compliance segment and a 10 minute live cost demo slot.

Confirmed — Wed May 5, 13:00–14:30 PDT works for our team. Attendees from Acme: myself, Emily (data science lead), and Priya (infra/security). I’ve created a temporary calendar event and shared a Google Meet link; attaching our brief environment note (data-residency-summary.pdf) for reference.

Quick answers to asks:
- Prompt examples & QPS: Emily will send 4 de-identified prompt examples + an expected 150 QPS peak for a subset of endpoints.
- Residency: primary training and customer PII stays in EU; we’ll want to validate private deployment options — Marissa, appreciate you covering that.
- Finance: please include the token-level cost slide in the deck; our procurement lead will join if the SOW timing looks reasonable.

I’ll accept the invite once you send it and we’ll be ready. Looking forward to it.
